close_reason: Renamed enum variants ParseError->AcParseError, SignatureInvalid->AcSignatureInvalid, ValidityPeriod->AcExpired to match the rustdoc comments. RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p pkix-ac --no-deps --all-features now passes.
description:
pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:119-121 references Error::AcParseError, Error::AcExpired, Error::AcSignatureInvalid in the # Errors rustdoc section of validate_attribute_cert. None of these variants exist — the actual variants are ParseError, ValidityPeriod, SignatureInvalid (lines 71-79).

Reproduction:
  RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p pkix-ac --no-deps --all-features
  -> error: unresolved link to `Error::AcParseError` (and 2 more)

Impact:
- docs.rs builds use -D warnings on broken-intra-doc-links and will fail (every published version of pkix-ac will have a red docs.rs page).
- Pass 1 P1 commit (e67f0c7b) explicitly claimed to fix rustdoc errors blocking docs.rs builds (PKIX-1b9p). It fixed pkix-lint but missed pkix-ac.

Fix: rename the references in the doc comment to match the actual variant names, OR rename the variants to match the docs (preferred since the names are less ambiguous):
  ParseError       -> AcParseError      (collision-resistant)
  ValidityPeriod   -> AcExpired         (matches doc text 'outside validity window')
  SignatureInvalid -> AcSignatureInvalid

Whichever direction, also add a CI step (RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features) so this regression cannot recur.
title: P1: pkix-ac rustdoc fails docs.rs build with -D warnings (3 broken intra-doc links to non-existent Error variants)
